caption: The video captures a fixed winter mountain view where a sunlit granite monolith rises on the left and snow-laden conifers fill the foreground. A thick band of white mist sits in the valley floor, while snow-covered peaks and a thin waterfall line the right side under a pastel sky. The scene is already in a slow ambient state. The pink cloud masses above shift faintly, and the blue patch near the top-center changes its soft outline gradually. The valley fog and the haze around the right-hand peaks become marginally more diffuse in places, thinning and brightening without revealing a clear direction of travel. The cliff edges, foreground trees, and peak outlines hold their positions steadily, so only the soft cloud and mist forms visibly evolve. The camera remains stationary throughout the view, leaving the landscape composition unchanged while the very slowly drifting atmospheric layer continues.
